This looks through the last 90 days of SMS for bank messages the app couldn't read, so support for them can be added.

resources.string: With no internet access, the app can\'t look for a newer version itself. The store it came from, or the release page, can.
You\'ve had version %1$s for a while. Budget Widget has no internet access, so it can\'t check by itself. Open the download page to see if there\'s a newer one.
This app cannot connect to the internet. Your SMS and spending never leave this phone. You can check it in App info.

Only SMS from banks are read, and only on this phone. Bank messages are stored here so you can see where a transaction came from; personal messages are never stored. There are no ads, no analytics and no accounts. Backups and exports are files you choose where to save.
